label: container-solver
command: import { generateBlueprintV2 } from "@designflow/generator"; import { auditBlueprint } from "@designflow/blueprint-qa"; import { calculateQuantityTakeoff } from "@designflow/quantity-takeoff"; const result=generateBlueprintV2({site:{boundary:[{x:0,z:0},{x:12000,z:0},{x:12000,z:16000},{x:0,z:16000}],northMilliDegrees:0},rooms:[{type:"bedroom",count:2},{type:"living",count:1},{type:"kitchen",count:1},{type:"bathroom",count:1}],seed:"phase19-container",layoutV2:{accessSide:"min-z",parking:{count:1}}}); const qa=auditBlueprint(result.model,{requireReachability:true}); const coverage=calculateQuantityTakeoff(result.model).coverage.find(c=>c.category==="parking_construction"); if(result.metadata.solverVersion!=="precision-blueprint-v2"||qa.status==="FAIL"||coverage?.status!=="NOT_EVALUATED") throw new Error("Container V2 acceptance failed"); console.log(JSON.stringify({generator:result.metadata.solverVersion,qa:qa.status,parkingCoverage:coverage.status,unreachable:qa.circulation.unreachableSpaceIds}));
